According to the data supplied by the Missouri Accountability Portal, two tax‑credit categories issued more than **$100 million** in a single calendar year between **2000 and 2004**:

| Year | Tax‑Credit Category | Issued Amount |

| 2002 | **Historic Preservation** | **$170,333,693.33** |

According to the data supplied by the Missouri Accountability Portal, two tax‑credit categories issued more than **$100 million** in a single calendar year between **2000 and 2004**:

| Year | Tax‑Credit Category | Issued Amount |
|------|---------------------|---------------|
| 2002 | **Historic Preservation** | **$170,333,693.33** |

These are the only categories that, in the public data set, exceeded the $100 million threshold in any year during that five‑year span.
